item.title: Release #051
item.description: Mr. Jazzek absolutely made it with his fresh "Oriental Swing" version featuring Lil Harding Arsmtrong. Electro Swing can't be more classic like this. It's a perfectly mix between vintage sound and club beats! Lillian Hardin Armstrong was a jazz pianist, composer, arranger and singer, and she was the second wife of Louis Armstrong, with whom she collaborated on many recordings in the 1920s.

item.title: Release #052
item.description: Riff Kitten - Never Mine - Electro Swing Thing #052. Riff Kitten comes around with one smasher after another. Here is a chilly downtempo track that is slightly melancholic, very catchy and groovy. Musically interesting Electro Swing with a nice relaxed singing female voice and a deep atmosphere. "Never Mine" is Dark Swing and Lounge Swing at it’s best. Riff Kitten is slowly becoming an outstanding artist in the Electro Swing genre! #ItMustSchwing

item.title: Release #053
item.description: The Honky Crew is an Electro Swing DJ and live musician producer duo from Budapest in Hungary. With electronic music roots from Ordiman as DJ and Laszlo Tamasi, who is a drummer and comes from the Rockabilly genre, you can see the Honky Crew also as live band on stage with guest musicians. The single "Can't Stop" sets a new Neo Swing and Electro Swing milestone. It has a catchy vocal hook, a flowing saxophone line and the ragtime piano as a base, which has become a trademark of their productions

item.description: Stay Home For A Future. Millions of Italians have to stay at home because of the corona virus, but can still make music on balconies. item.description: Electro Swing artists get creative at home. It's a tough time for all of us. In the Corona crisis we sit at home and eat, read, skype, stream videos and listen to music. item.title: Release #058
item.description: "Funiculi Funicula" is a Neapolitan song composed in 1880 by Luigi Denza to lyrics by Peppino Turco. It was written to commemorate the opening of the first funicular railway on Mount Vesuvius! Mr. Jazzek has re-produced it to a fresh Electro Swing banger, together with the singer Felipe Céspedes from Chile. The melody theme is well known and it brings the past to the present. You can feel the melancholie and hapiness from this time period. Vintage feeling and modern club beats mixed in one Elect

item.title: Release #059
item.description: Schinowatz is an Electro Swing DJ, musician and producer veteran from Austria. He always brings his skills and experience into his very authentic and classic Swing House productions. With „Snake Eyes“ he grabbed a classic by Tiny Parham from 1928 and transformed it with modern club beats into a bouncing Electro Swing cracker!

item.title: Release #060
item.description: Papa Tony from Russia comes up and surprises with an Electro Swing anthem. It sounds really likey classic Swing House and Electro Swing from the first days of this genre. It's a mix of Russian Folk, Gypsy, Minimal and Tech house that Parov Stelar couldn't have done better. A deep groove and melancholic swing riffs that based on a very solid club beat! #WelcomeBack20s

item.title: Release #074
item.description: The Honky Crew is back! For the new single ‘Get Up’, the Hungarian producer duo teamed up with Italian singer Dani Milano and wrote a new Neo Swing smasher. The Honky Crew are again working with the ragtime piano, a lively saxophone and with the soft voice of Dani Milano. Swing House club beats meet catchy melodies and swinging vintage grooves!

item.title: Release #075
item.description: Welcome Crazy Red Balls to the Neo Swing world! Their new single Moon Fly is dedicated to all astronauts out there. It starts with a legendary phrase by Neil Armstrong: "That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind." The first verse is borrowed from Jack London’s "Like Argus of the ancient times".
